caption: Quantile-regression coefficient of SPY forward returns on the SOX/SPY relative strength signal across return quantiles 0.05–0.95 with 95% CI. The coefficient is positive and significant in the LOWER quantiles (tau 0.05–0.50) and fades to zero in the upper quantiles — the relative-strength signal carries more information about avoiding bad outcomes than about chasing big up-moves.
